0280:         scenario

0290:             f"changed: {current_index}"
0291:         )
0292: 
0293:     classes = []

0298:             index
0299:         ]
0300:

0302:             int(
0303:                 track.object_type
0304:             )
0305:         )
0306: 
0307:         row = []
0308:

0310:             HORIZON_FRAME_OFFSETS
0311:         ):

0320:                 <
0321:                 len(

0330:             )
0331:

0336:             )
